reason: I'm driving between job sites all day and I have more work than time. I'd say 'email me something' and never get back to it. Even if it looks nice, I don't have time to sit down for a lunch demo this month.

would_change_my_mind: A live sample of one of my own plans, sent to me with no meeting, where revisions are included or cheap enough that I'm not paying per change.
